data.text: doc edit DOC-N with no text opens $EDITOR from the current revision; unchanged or empty writes nothing; no terminal -> exit 2 with --file/--body. Found before writing it: editText strips lines starting with '#', git-style, which would have deleted every Markdown heading; documents now get the hint in one HTML comment and only that is removed. Verified through a real pseudo-terminal (script -q) with an editor script that appends a line: headings kept, revision 2. That check first failed for a reason worth knowing: GIT_EDITOR wins over EDITOR in resolveEditor, and agent shells set GIT_EDITOR=true, so 'my editor did nothing' was the environment. Seen to fail first: 7/7 red before the change.
